name: Superstition Mountains: Lost Dutchman Expedition
description: A 3D open-world desert survival exploration game in Arizona's Superstition Wilderness with dynamic Haboob sandstorms, hunker-down survival mechanics, voiced historic Tortilla Flat townfolk NPCs, frontier law enforcement and Territorial Most Wanted outlaw posse mobilization, desert hydrology, wilderness camping, real-time multiplayer, and underground mining.
